teaching_checks.reason: States supplied files and the practical route before power-on. Hardware requirements are a prepared configuration with a reference, not a setup procedure. Model-screen origin is explicit.
The screen grounds volume and current-drive definitions. Automatic startup is distinguished from reader input without loader, driver-installation or alternate-console teaching.
DIR action and Return precede the result. Names, ASM/COM and the assembler follow the visible listing. Free-space units are explained beside the count. No host preparation is needed.

Keys are given before later commands. Ctrl notation precedes its table; correction, whole-line discard and recall are concrete actions. The program-input limitation and empty-prompt Ctrl-C cross-reference prevent transfer of the table to unrelated input.
Drive letters and a concrete B-to-A round trip precede the build. Source-to-COM assembly is explained through supplied SAMPLE. An edit requires reassembly. Run output ends at a fresh prompt.

Completed application save/exit, an empty line, Ctrl-C without Return and a fresh successful prompt form the practical route. Write lost is explicitly failed preservation, dropped writes cannot be recovered by retry and a flush cannot save unsaved editor text. Card removal/reset precautions are actions rather than cache architecture.

craft_checks.journey: prepared machine -> prompt -> DIR/names -> correction/recall -> drive changes -> supplied build/run -> preservation
craft_checks.deletion_read: No required structural deletion. Repeated current-drive wording links drive selection to the build. Short action introductions lead to real examples. The final removal/reset sentence adds an operation rather than recapping.
craft_checks.agency: No false interior or social agency found. Subjects perform typing, reading, writing, loading, conversion or reported output.
craft_checks.punctuation: All complete paragraphs and key rows read jointly. Definitions and supplementary phrases retain their boundaries; literal numeric grouping and excerpt punctuation are immutable. Three optional joins are recorded below.
craft_checks.mechanical_search: Explicit vocabulary, throat-clearing, importance, copula, mind-verb and punctuation search performed; matches read in full contexts. No new gate/test/runtime was run for this review.
